landing.hero_description: Create private spaces for your squad, share photos, memories, and moments strictly between yourselves. And when hanging out, easily split group expenses without messy calculations. Fast login via Telegram.

highlights.private_desc: Posts and photos are visible only to company members
highlights.smart_splits_desc: Simple expense splitting after parties and road trips

example_box.title: Example: Squad party or a weekend getaway
example_box.text: You got together with your crew for a hangout or trip. One person covers food and drinks. They simply create a split inside your company, enter the total bill, and Ours Hub calculates everyone's share while showing who paid and who owes.

features.title: Everything for a warm vibe
features.subtitle: No public feed, no strangers, and no awkward math after parties.

company.title: Private Companies
company.desc: Create separate spaces for your closest friends, roommates, or travel buddies. Everything posted inside stays strictly between you.

media.title: A feed for yourselves
media.desc: Share photos, inside jokes, and party memories. Zero algorithms and zero strangers.

splits.title: Effortless splits
splits.desc: Someone bought snacks and drinks for the party? Create a split in your company and easily keep track of who contributed.

auth.title: Telegram login
auth.desc: No tedious registration forms or passwords to memorize. One click with Telegram and you are with your squad.

transparency.title: Complete transparency
transparency.desc: Everyone in the company sees who covered the bill, who already sent their share, and what's left.

custom_shares.title: Flexible splitting
custom_shares.desc: Split equally among all participants or set individual amounts when someone ordered separately.

how_it_works.title: Super straightforward
how_it_works.subtitle: Get started and hang out with your crew in less than a minute.
how_it_works.step1_desc: No emails or passwords — just authenticate in one click.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Invite your friends using a direct invite link.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Post photos, inside memes, and plan your next hangouts.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Create splits for group purchases and track contributions.

use_cases.title: Built for shared memories
use_cases.item1_desc: Birthdays, celebrations, or weekend hangouts — settle the table bill without messy calculators.
use_cases.item2_desc: Cabin rentals, road trips, barbecues — keep shared memories and split expenses fairly.
use_cases.item3_desc: Utilities, apartment groceries, and a private cozy chat all in one space.
use_cases.item4_desc: Inside jokes, photo dumps, and a comfortable sanctuary for your inner circle.

cta_banner.title: Bring your squad together
cta_banner.subtitle: Create a cozy private space for your friends and enjoy your time together without friction.
